svg.title: RAW IP: the version nibble decides
svg.desc: Frame 1 of ndpi_pfcp.pcapng starts directly at the IPv4 header: the first byte 45 carries the version nibble 4 that selects the IPv4 decoder, then IHL 5, DSCP, total length 52, identification, flags, TTL 64, protocol 17 (UDP), checksum and the two loopback addresses; RawIpLink records ip_version 4 and hands the whole 52 bytes to the internet layer.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
